policy: Same-named Mega art from multiple sources is one approval concept with side-by-side art options.
X/Y/Z, regional Mega, Redux Mega, and other explicitly distinct Mega concepts remain separate.
Custom Mega is preferred over Gigantamax art when both exist.
Official canon Mega remains source of truth when the Mega itself is canon.
next_action: Resolve the remaining 68 species with genuinely different Mega concepts, then apply the same concept-collapse process to Delta/Redux/regional/evolution pools.
